leadText:
Rena Nounen (Japanese: 能年 玲奈 Nōnen Rena), She made her modelling debut in 2006 and her acting debut in 2010. debuting with single Ohirome Pack in 2017 and her first album called Superhero's in 2018. 

In 2023, she provided the Japanese voice of Haru in the Netflix stop-motion animated series Pokémon Concierge. In 2025, she released the song GwGw produced by for the Pokémon Music Collective collaboration project.
